newsitem.title: USA: Media Logic proposes $4 financing pact.
newsitem.headline: Media Logic proposes $4 financing pact.

text.p: Media Logic Inc on Friday said it proposes to enter into a $4 million financing agreement to allow the firm to bring its accounts payable current and to continue research and development.
The automated data tape library developer also said it would use the funds to enhance its sales and marketing program and for working capitol.
Media Logic said that pursuant to the financing, it will issue debentures which will be convertible into shares of the company's stock.
The company said that is has previously disclosed that it could be forced to cease operation if financing is not obtained before March 31, 1997.

The debentures will be convertible at a price equal to 120 percent of the average closing bid price of the stock as calculated over the five trading day period ending on the date of subscrition, or 80 percent of the average closing stock bid as calculated over the five day trading period ending on the day prior to submission of each conversion's notice, whichever is lower.
